commit.message:
feat(f1): credential separation — close circular trust (DEV-CYCLE-001)

Migration 20260823163000_f1_signature_verification_credential_separation_v1:
- f1_verifier_writer NOLOGIN role: the only writer identity for signature
  verification receipts (granted ONLY through supervisor-tier verifier
  activation; NEVER statically to service_role)
- h205f22_record_signature_verification_guarded_v1: wraps the recorder —
  active-verifier row check + pg_has_role(f1_verifier_writer) caller check;
  service_role without the writer role fails 42501 EVEN WITH an active
  verifier (the negative canary case — kills the create-then-read-own-proof
  circular trust identified by GPT review + GLM structural confirmation)
- revoke insert/update/delete on the trust plane (provider_signature_
  verification + signature_verifier_registry) from service_role —
  same proven pattern as W1 migration 20260823141025
- reader path unchanged: service_role readback RPC stays read-only

Tests: tests/f1/test_credential_separation.py — 7/7 PASS (mocked-role model
of the SQL semantics for CI; live canary runs post-apply in supervisor
channel). PREPARE_ONLY: versioned for supervisor apply; no authority grant,
no evidence rows.

Addresses GPT CHANGES_REQUIRED verdict (reader/forger separation).
Domains: federation/provider/signature. authority_effect=false.
